text: Given a valid X-Square-Access-Token header, when any tool is called, then the outbound Square request carries Authorization: Bearer <token> and no server-side stored credential is used.
Given no X-Square-Access-Token header, when POST /mcp tools/call is sent, then the response is 401 listing the required header and zero outbound Square calls are made.

Given X-Square-Environment: sandbox, when any tool is called, then the outbound request targets https://connect.squareupsandbox.com/v2; given the header is omitted or 'production', it targets https://connect.squareup.com/v2.
Given X-Square-Environment set to a value other than production or sandbox, when any tool is called, then it returns an invalid_argument error and makes no outbound call.
Given two concurrent tools/call requests with two different tokens/environments, when both run at the same time, then each resolves a SquareClient carrying only its own token and base URL.
GET /health returns 200 {"status": "ok", ...} with no Square credential configured anywhere.
A tools/list call with no prior initialize session succeeds with HTTP 200 (stateless Streamable HTTP).
square_list_locations calls GET /v2/locations and returns locations with id, name, and status.
square_list_customers with no arguments calls GET /v2/customers and returns a page of customers plus a cursor when more results exist.
square_search_customers with email_address and given_name builds a POST /v2/customers/search filter containing exactly those fields and returns the matches.
square_get_customer with an existing customer_id calls GET /v2/customers/{customer_id} and returns that customer's detail.
square_get_customer with a non-existent customer_id returns a not_found error envelope, not an unhandled exception.
square_list_catalog_items calls GET /v2/catalog/list?types=ITEM (with cursor when provided) and returns catalog items.
square_get_catalog_item returns the object for an existing object_id, and not_found for a non-existent one.
square_search_orders builds POST /v2/orders/search with exactly the filters provided (location_ids, state, date filters, cursor) and returns matching orders.
square_get_order returns the order for an existing order_id, and not_found for a non-existent one.
square_list_payments passes exactly the query parameters provided (location_id, begin_time, end_time, cursor) to GET /v2/payments.
square_get_payment returns the payment for an existing payment_id, and not_found for a non-existent one.
square_get_inventory_count calls GET /v2/inventory/{catalog_object_id}, passing location_ids as a query filter when provided, and returns current stock counts.
square_create_refund without an idempotency_key generates one, calls POST /v2/refunds, and returns the created refund (id, status, amount_money).
Two calls to square_create_refund with the same idempotency_key and arguments produce the same refund result; Square is not treated as having processed two refunds.
Square rejecting a refund (e.g. amount exceeds refundable balance) returns a structured error with Square's upstream code/message, not an unhandled exception.
A representative 4xx and a representative 5xx response from Square each map to the correct envelope code; a 429 on a read call is retried honoring Retry-After before giving up.
README documents all 12 tools and both authentication headers.
steps: Open README.md on the work branch
expect: Tool List has 12 rows (one per tool in the Change list) with description and key parameters in the sibling-pattern shape; Authentication headers documents X-Square-Access-Token (required) and X-Square-Environment (optional, default production).

text: End-to-end confirmation against a real Square sandbox account (optional, not blocking per SOP -- missing a vendor test account is not a blocker).
steps: Obtain a real Square sandbox access token with a test location, customer, catalog item, and a completed test payment
Call square_list_locations, square_get_customer, square_get_payment, then square_create_refund for a small amount against that payment
Check the Square sandbox dashboard for the resulting refund
expect: Each read tool returns data matching the sandbox dashboard; the refund appears against the payment with the requested amount.
evidence: No real Square sandbox account is available to DEV01 at design time. Not a blocker per SOP (missing vendor test account does not block delivery).
